name: Fitness API Docs Drift 2026 (how often the sources behind this site's quotes changed)
methodology: Every evidence row (a claim, a source URL and a verbatim quote) in ops/sources/evidence/*.json of the aifitnessapi repository, followed through the 27 commits that touched those files from 2026-10-17 to 2026-11-14 (main at 5b095e4). A row is written by the commit that first holds it and ends at the commit after which the file no longer holds it. endKind says how: quote or url when the same claim survives with a different quote or URL, url-and-quote for both, claim-reworded when the same URL and quote survive under a new claim, removed otherwise. cause and kind come only from the ending commit's own message, through ops/research/docs-drift-annotations.json, whose every statement is checked against that message; statement is that text. source-changed means the message says the vendor's page changed; our-change that this site changed the quote or URL and the source did not; source-unreachable that the page stopped answering; not-stated that the message does not say. Rows that share every column are one line, and rows counts them. Dates are merge dates on main, so a row written in a branch days earlier carries the merge date. The method sees only what was committed: a source that changed and changed back between reads, a page no row quotes, or a change the weekly quote check did not catch is invisible to it.
generatedFrom: src/data/researchStudies.ts DRIFT_GROUPS (generated by scripts/build-research.mjs from the git history, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.source: The source's host, or host/owner for raw.githubusercontent.com and github.com
fields.writtenOn: Merge date of the commit that first held the row
fields.endedOn: Merge date of the commit after which the file no longer held the row; null while it still does
fields.endedCommit: That commit, abbreviated; null while the row is live
fields.endKind: quote, url, url-and-quote, claim-reworded or removed (see methodology); null while live
fields.cause: source-changed, our-change, source-unreachable or not-stated, from the ending commit's message; null while live
fields.kind: fact, wording or mixed, where the ending commit's message says which; null otherwise
fields.statement: The text of the ending commit's message the cause and kind come from
fields.rows: How many evidence rows share every other column
